title: Jelly Roll Proto — Map Data Contract
description: Shared schema between the game (jelly-roll-proto) and map converter (pml-to-ldtk). Defines what entities, tiles, and level structures the game understands. The converter MUST produce LDtk data conforming to this contract.

level.identifier_note: N is a zero-based integer index. Used as room key for persistence and door targeting.
level.variable_rooms_note: Rooms can be any multiple of grid_size. Vertical shafts (128x384), large arenas, etc.

intgrid.description: IntGrid value → tile behavior mapping. The game reads IntGrid.csv from simplified export.

10.name: goo_mold
10.note: Negative Space biome gate. Reserved for acid or late-game ability.

6.name: water
6.note: Passable zone. Drains juice when Bubble Shield active.

reserved_ranges.6-8: Zone hazard tiles (water, acid, lava) — Phase 9

entities.description: Entity definitions the game can instantiate. Names must match exactly.

PlayerStart.description: Player spawn point. One per world.

Door.description: Room transition gate. Closed by default, opened by kick or spit. Triggers room transition when open + player collision.

target_level_id.description: Index of the destination level (0-based). Game converts to 'Level_{N}' identifier.

direction.description: Direction the door faces. Determines player nudge on entry and entrance door detection.

Door.note: Place doors at room boundaries. Bidirectional: room A needs a door pointing to B, room B needs one pointing to A.

Snail.description: Ground-patrolling enemy. Walks back and forth on platforms.

Bat.description: Flying enemy. Dives toward player when in range.

BossMole.description: Giant Mole boss. Triggers boss fight with gate lockdown.
BossMole.note: One per world. Gates close on trigger, open on defeat.

DashPickup.description: Dash ability pickup. Grants basic dash dodge (D-15).
DashPickup.persistence_note: Tracked by LDtk iid. Never respawns once collected.

ShieldPickup.description: Bubble Shield T1 ability pickup. Grants hazard zone protection (ABL-05).
ShieldPickup.persistence_note: Tracked by LDtk iid. Never respawns once collected.

BoostPickup.description: Slime Boost ability pickup. Grants fused vertical burst (ABL-06).

ShieldT2.description: Enhanced Bubble Shield pickup. Reduces drain rates (D-05).

pivot_convention.description: All entities use center pivot in LDtk for grid alignment. The game converts center coords to top-left on spawn by subtracting half width/height.

simplified_export.description: The game reads LDtk simplified export format.
